name: Negative: Incomplete information triggers missing detail request
objective: Validate that Agentforce requests missing details when user provides incomplete information for incident creation.
precondition: Portal user logged in, Agentforce chat open.

steps.description: Send message requesting incident without specifying details
steps.testData: I want to create an incident but I don't know what category to use
steps.expectedResult: Agent asks user to describe the issue in detail to help select the category
No INC- number in the conversation

executionResult.agentResponse: If you're not sure about which category to use for your incident, you can describe your issue in detail and I will help you select the most appropriate category. Please provide a brief summary of the problem you are experiencing, and I will guide you through the next steps.
